sources.guidance_2026: Press release 17-Sep-2026 'Exosens raises full-year 2026 guidance' (revenue EUR 558-570m; adjusted EBITDA EUR 186-192m; capex ~9% of revenue excl. capitalized R&D ~3%), confirmed in the 9M-2026 release (27-Oct-2026). Original FY26 guidance EUR 520-540m / EUR 168-178m (FY2025 release, 23-Feb-2026; 'towards the upper end' in the H1-2026 release, 28-Jul-2026).
sources.medium_term: URD 2025 section 5.8.1 / FY2025 release: medium-term average annual organic revenue growth up to mid-teens; organic adjusted EBITDA growth above 15% (mild progressive margin improvement); normalized capex ~5% of revenue after the capacity expansion completes in 2027 (+ capitalized R&D ~3%); dividend payout 20-25% of net income; leverage may temporarily reach ~2x for acquisitions; EUR 1bn revenue ambition.
sources.q3_2026: 9M-2026 release (27-Oct-2026): Q3-2026 revenue by segment and adjusted gross margin (appendix), Q3 like-for-like +20.5%.
sources.share_price: Euronext Paris live quote feed (live.euronext.com, ISIN FR001400Q9V2-XPAR): close EUR 56.90 on 30-Oct-2026 (last trade EUR 57.25 at 14:41 CET on 2-Nov-2026). URD 2025 section 7.4.2: EUR 48.45 at 31-Dec-2025.
sources.shares: Monthly share-count notice 1-Oct-2026: 50,936,749 shares at 30-Sep-2026 (59,173,206 exercisable voting rights). H1-2026 report Note 24: 25,873 treasury shares (liquidity contract); LTIP 2025-2026 (216,750 performance shares) and LTIP 2026-2028 (197,000) outstanding; weighted average H1-2026 50,441,791.
sources.financing: H1-2026 report section 1.4 and Note 25: Term Loan B EUR 250m bullet (first drawdown Jun-2024, 5-year maturity, i.e. Jun-2029), 3M Euribor + 0.95-1.75% (1.15% at 1.0-1.5x leverage after the 3-Jun-2026 renegotiation); RCF EUR 200m undrawn (commitment to Jun-2029; margin 0.55-1.75%, 0.75% at 1.0-1.5x; non-utilisation fee 35% of margin); EIB EUR 140m facility (24-Jun-2026, up to 7 years, bullet, undrawn; illustrative fixed 4.08% at 1.0-2.0x); other loans EUR 4.6m; leases EUR 17.75m. Covenant: net debt / adjusted EBITDA <= 3.0x.
